name: TCIA_list_collections
description: List all publicly available imaging collections in The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA). TCIA is a large archive of medical images of cancer available for public download. Returns collection names for use with other TCIA tools.

oneOf.description: List of collection objects with Collection field

error.description: Error message if the request failed

name: TCIA_get_series
description: Get imaging series from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA). A series is a set of related images from a single imaging session. Returns metadata including modality, body part, patient ID, image count, and file size. Filter by collection name, patient ID, study UID, modality, or body part. Example collections: 'TCGA-GBM', 'LIDC-IDRI', 'TCGA-LUAD', 'TCGA-BRCA'.

AnnotationsFlag.description: True when the series carries annotations - segmentations or measurements. Measured on 918 of 1018 series, and the difference between raw images and a labelled dataset.

CollectionURI.description: DOI of the collection the series belongs to, e.g. 'https://doi.org/10.7937/K9/TCIA.2015.LO9QL9SX'. The citation the collection's own terms require.

DateReleased.description: When TCIA published the series, e.g. '2020-02-21 15:12:49.0'.

LicenseName.description: Licence the images are released under, e.g. 'Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported License'. Whether the data may be redistributed or used commercially - and nothing else in the row says.

Manufacturer.description: Scanner manufacturer, e.g. 'GE MEDICAL SYSTEMS'. Quantitative imaging features are not comparable across vendors.

SeriesNumber.description: DICOM series number within the study, e.g. 3000566. Measured on 884 of 1018 series, so it cannot be relied on to order them.

SoftwareVersions.description: Scanner software version, e.g. 'LightSpeedApps2.4.2_H2.4M5'. Measured on 936 of 1018 series.

StudyDate.description: Date of the study, e.g. '2000-01-01 00:00:00.0'. TCIA shifts dates during de-identification, so it preserves intervals rather than real dates.

TimeStamp.description: TCIA's own record timestamp for the series.

error.description: Error message if the request failed

name: TCIA_get_patient_studies
description: Get study information for patients in The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA). Returns study metadata including study date, description, and patient details. Filter by collection name or patient ID.

Collection.description: The TCIA collection the study belongs to, e.g. 'LIDC-IDRI'. Each collection has its own licence and citation requirement.

PatientName.description: DICOM PatientName. Measured NULL on every study: TCIA removes it during de-identification, so it is a declared-but-always-empty field rather than missing data.

SeriesCount.description: How many series the study contains, e.g. 1. Says how much there is to fetch before fetching it.

error.description: Error message if the request failed

name: TCIA_get_modality_values
description: Get the imaging modalities available in a specific TCIA collection or across all collections. Returns modality codes such as CT, MR, PT (PET), CR, DX, US (ultrasound), NM.

Collection.description: Collection name to filter by (e.g., 'LIDC-IDRI'). Omit to get all modalities.

error.description: Error message if the request failed

name: TCIA_get_body_part_values
description: Get the body parts examined in TCIA imaging collections. Returns body part names for filtering series queries. Optionally filter by collection or modality.

BodyPartExamined.description: One DICOM BodyPartExamined value, e.g. 'ABDOMEN'. Free text filled in by the acquiring site, so the same anatomy appears under several spellings.

error.description: Error message if the request failed

name: TCIA_get_series_metadata
description: Get detailed DICOM metadata for a specific imaging series in TCIA by its Series Instance UID. Returns equipment information, acquisition parameters, and series attributes.

oneOf.description: List of metadata key-value pairs for the series

items.description: One DICOM series, keyed by the metadata field name as TCIA spells it -- 'Body Part Examined', 'Series Date', 'Number of Images'. The names contain SPACES and come from the DICOM dictionary, and which appear depends on the modality, so this is read as a map rather than by fixed attribute names.

additionalProperties.description: The value of that DICOM field.

error.description: Error message if the request failed

name: TCIA_get_series_size
description: Get the total file size and image count for a specific imaging series in The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA). Returns total size in bytes and number of DICOM objects. Use this to estimate download sizes before retrieving imaging data. Obtain SeriesInstanceUID from TCIA_get_series results.

SeriesInstanceUID.description: DICOM Series Instance UID. Example: '1.3.6.1.4.1.14519.5.2.1.6279.6001.100225287222365663678666836860'. Obtain from TCIA_get_series results.

oneOf.description: Array with one element containing size information

error.description: Error message if the request failed

name: TCIA_get_patients
description: List the patients (subjects) in a TCIA imaging collection. Returns patient-level fields not available from study-level tools: PatientId, PatientName, Phantom (whether the subject is a phantom test object vs a real patient), and SpeciesCode/SpeciesDescription (e.g. '337915000' / 'Homo sapiens'). Use this to enumerate subjects and filter human vs phantom/animal subjects. Filter by collection name. Example collections: 'LIDC-IDRI', 'TCGA-GBM', 'TCGA-LUAD'.

Collection.description: Collection name to list patients for (e.g., 'LIDC-IDRI', 'TCGA-GBM'). Omit to list patients across all collections.

PatientName.description: Patient name (usually empty for de-identified data)

Phantom.description: 'YES' if the subject is a phantom test object, 'NO' for a real patient

SpeciesCode.description: SNOMED species code (e.g., '337915000' for Homo sapiens)

error.description: Error message if the request failed

name: TCIA_get_sop_instance_uids
description: List the SOP Instance UIDs of every individual DICOM image (slice) within a TCIA imaging series. This is the deepest granularity below a series: each returned object is a single image instance. Use this to enumerate or reference individual slices. Requires a SeriesInstanceUID, obtained from TCIA_get_series results.

SeriesInstanceUID.description: DICOM Series Instance UID. Example: '1.3.6.1.4.1.14519.5.2.1.6279.6001.179049373636438705059720603192'. Obtain from TCIA_get_series results.

oneOf.description: List of SOP Instance UID objects, one per image/slice

SOPInstanceUID.description: DICOM SOP Instance UID of a single image

error.description: Error message if the request failed

name: TCIA_get_manufacturer_values
description: Get the distinct scanner Manufacturer values present in a TCIA collection (optionally filtered by modality or body part). This is a faceting tool analogous to TCIA_get_modality_values and TCIA_get_body_part_values, but for equipment manufacturer (e.g., 'GE MEDICAL SYSTEMS', 'SIEMENS', 'Philips', 'TOSHIBA'). Use to discover which scanner vendors appear in a collection.

Collection.description: Collection name to filter by (e.g., 'LIDC-IDRI'). Omit to get manufacturers across all collections.

error.description: Error message if the request failed
